neighbours.label: ' to' that completes a preceding noun or adjective (in response to, an effort to, interesting to, expensive to), as against 'to' marking motion toward a place or the recipient of a giving verb
fire: The mayor spoke to reporters in response to the flooding downtown.

Hospitals are expensive to run in rural parts of the country.
The company changed its policy in response to complaints from staff.

The school sent a letter to every family in the district.

The nurse handed the chart to the doctor on duty.

Volunteers carried the trees to the far end of the field.
